story.label: About J&B Rooms
story.headline: From 9 rooms to a multi-location portfolio
story.p1: J&B Rooms was founded in 2019 by Hie Yenny Kristina. It started with a single property: J&B Rooms Pramuka, which opened with 9 rooms.
story.p2: Since then, J&B Rooms has grown into a multi-location hotel management portfolio across Jakarta, Greater Jakarta and beyond — partnering with property owners to operate hotels that perform for owners, guests and teams alike.
story.imageAlt: J&B Rooms Pramuka, the company’s first property
